title: DoorDash says the FAA granted it Part 135 air carrier certification to operate a drone delivery service and it plans to launch drone deliveries in the fall (Natalie Lung/Bloomberg)
summary: Natalie Lung / Bloomberg: DoorDash says the FAA granted it Part 135 air carrier certification to operate a drone delivery service and it plans to launch drone deliveries in the fall — DoorDash Inc. is building its own delivery drones and has gained the necessary approvals to operate them commercially …
